macros.name: dbalph
macros.doc: Show the counter of query set as lowercase letters.

macros.name: dbAlph
macros.doc: Show the counter of query set as uppercase letters.

macros.name: dbarabic
macros.doc: Show the counter of query set as digits.

macros.name: dbdatesep
macros.doc: Set the separator for internal date parsing.

macros.name: dbIfEmptyF
macros.doc: Test if the database is empty.

macros.name: dbIfLastF
macros.doc: Test if the current item is the last item to display.

macros.name: dbIntDivTruncate
macros.doc: Use \dbIntDivTruncate to rounds the result toward 0.

macros.name: dbNewStyle
macros.doc: Define a new ⟨style⟩ that binds to ⟨database⟩.

macros.name: dbroman
macros.doc: Show the counter of query set as lowercase roman numerals.

macros.name: dbtoday
macros.doc: \dbtoday show the current date with the separator defined by \dbdatesep.

macros.name: dbuse
macros.doc: You can use \dbuse to denote the value of attribute.

macros.name: dbval
macros.doc: \dbval is replaced with the real value of the attribute inside the ⟨cond spec⟩.

envs.name: dbFilters
envs.doc: Filters are defined inside dbFilters environment, inside which, \dbNewConditional is defined to declare conditionals and \dbCombineConditionals is defined to combine conditionals.

envs.name: dbitem
envs.doc: The data are stored with dbitem environment in two ways. Short data can be stored in ⟨attr-val list⟩ and long data can be stored by \dbsave, which will suppress the value set by the option list.
